description: Analysis of mammary epithelial MCF10A/HER2/FKBP/HA cells treated with AP1510 to induce the chimeric HER2-FKBP molecule to homodimerize, or with TGFa or heregulin to induce heterodimerization with EGFR or HER3. Results provide insight into signaling events following HER2 receptor dimerization.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: p53 mutations in microsatellite-stable, stage III colorectal cancer
description: Analysis of Stage III CRCs exhibiting microsatellite-stable (MSS) and mutant p53 phenotypic features. p53 mutations are associated with higher Stage III MSS CRC mortality than p53 wild-type phenotypes. Results provide further insight into the prognostic value of p53 mutations in Stage III MSS CRCs.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Hepatitis B virus (HBV)-associated acute liver failure (ALF) patients: liver explant
description: Analysis of explanted livers of 4 patients with HBV-associated ALF who underwent liver transplantation. Liver has inherent regenerative capacity via hepatic stem/progenitor cells (HSPC) when hepatic loss is massive. Results provide insight into role of HSPC in liver regeneration associated with ALF.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: External beam radiation therapy effect on prostate cancer patients: peripheral white blood cells
description: Analysis of peripheral blood from men with non-metastatic prostate cancer (PC) on days 1, 7, 14, 21, 42 of external beam radiation therapy (EBRT), and at 30 days post-EBRT. Fatigue is a common side effect of EBRT. Results provide insight into molecular basis of fatigue in men with PC during EBRT.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: bHLH transcription factor Mesogenin1 ectopic expression effect on embryoid bodies: time course
description: Analysis of embryoid bodies following induction of ectopic Msgn1 expression for up to 48 hours. Msgn1, a bHLH transcription factor, is a target of Wnt3a, a signaling protein that functions in the segmentation clock and the determination front during somitogenesis.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: KrasG12D pancreatic ductal epithelial cells deficient in PTEN
description: Analysis of primary pancreatic ductal epithelial cells (PDECs) established from 6-week-old Pdx1-Cre;LSL-KrasG12D L/+;Pten L/+ animals. Oncogenic KrasG12D and Pten deficiency cooperate to induce pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC). Results provide insight into molecular basis of PDAC development.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Effect of ischemia and tissue procurement conditions on resected renal clear cell carcinoma
description: Analysis of ten renal tumors that were resected then immediately frozen or stored at 4C, 22C, 37C for up to 240 minutes. Results provide insight into the impact of tissue acquisition method on tumor gene expression profiles.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: TYK2 and STAT1 silencing effect on JURKAT T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia cell line
description: Analysis of JURKAT cells transduced with TYK2 and STAT1 shRNAs. JAK tyrosine kinase TYK2 and downstream effector STAT1 promote survival of T-ALL cells. Results provide insight into the molecular mechanisms underlying TYK2-STAT1 pathway dependence in T-cell ALL.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Dual specificity phosphatase-4 loss effect on basal-like breast cancer cell lines
description: Analysis of basal-like breast cancer (BLBC) cell lines following DUSP4-knockdown or MAP-ERK kinase (MEK)-inhibition with AZD6244/selumetinib (up to 24hr). Results provide insight into role of DUSP4 in promoting cancer stem cell-like phenotypes in BLBC.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Radiation chimera model: Trp53-null mammary tumors arising from irradiated, wildtype hosts
description: Analysis of Trp53-null mammary tumors arising from WT hosts cleared of mammary gland epithelium, irradiated, then transplanted with nonmalignant Trp53-null mammary tissue. Results provide insight into the influence of the radiation response of the microenvironment on the carcinogenic process.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Radiation chimera model: Trp53-null mammary tumors arising from irradiated, TGFb1 heterozygote hosts
description: Analysis of Trp53-null tumors arising from Tgfb1+/- hosts cleared of mammary gland epithelia, irradiated, then transplanted with nonmalignant Trp53-null mammary tissue. TGF-B drives EMT and is highly induced by IR. Results provide insight into host biology contributions to radiation carcinogenesis.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: WTX overexpression effect on kidney cell line
description: Analysis of HEK293 embryonic kidney cells overexpressing WTX, a tumor suppressor frequently inactivated in Wilms tumor. Ectopic expression of WTX in HEK293 cells activates p53 through lysine acetylation. Results provide insight into a role for WTX in the regulation of p53 activity.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Lung response to thoracic irradiation: dose response and time course
description: Analysis of total lung from C57Bl/Ncr females exposed to 0, 5, or 17.5 Gy at 2, 4, 8, 16, and 30 weeks after thoracic irradiation. The lungs show extensive fibrosis at 30 weeks after 17.5 Gy. Results provide insight into molecular mechanisms underlying radiation-induced pulmonary fibrosis (RIPF).
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Prostate cancer
description: Analysis of malignant and benign prostate tissues. Results provide insight into a gene expression signature for prostate cancer.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Cediranib effect on metastatic alveolar soft part sarcoma
description: Analysis of metastatic alveolar soft part sarcoma (ASPS) biopsies from patients treated with cediranib, a small-molecule inhibitor of vascular endothelial growth factor receptors. Results provide insight into molecular mechanisms underlying the substantial single-agent activity of cediranib on ASPS.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: C-C Chemokine receptor 5 deficient lungs with melanoma metastasis: time course
description: Analysis of lungs from CCR5-deficient mutants 6 to 48 hrs after tail vein injection with B16-F10 melanoma cells. Lungs of CCR5-deficient mutants develop fewer metastatic nodules than in wild type animals. Results provide insight into the molecular mechanisms underlying CCR5-dependent metastasis.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Heart response to isocitrate dehydrogenase 2 mutations IDH2R140Q and IDH2R172K
description: Analysis of hearts from transgenics with conditionally-activated isocitrate dehydrogenase 2 mutant (IDH2) R140Q and R172K alleles. Mutant IDH2 causes cardiomyopathy and neurodegeneration. Results provide insight into molecular mechanisms underlying the cardiac defects associated with IDH2 mutations.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Transcription factor ETS fusion EWS/FLI1 knockdown in Ewing sarcoma cell line: time course
description: Analysis of A673 Ewing Sarcoma cell line for up to 96hrs after inducible EWSR1/FLI1 knockdown. Oncogenic ETS fusions are driver mutations in diverse cancers, including Ewing sarcoma. Results provide insight into the molecular mechanisms underlying ETS-driven tumorigenesis.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Ataxin-1-like knock out effect on hematopoietic stem cells
description: Analysis of hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) purified from the bone marrow of Ataxin-1-like (Atxn1L) null C57Bl/6 mice at 8 weeks of age. The ataxia-associated Atxn1L gene is highly expressed in HSCs. Results provide insight into the role of Atxn-1L in HSC function.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: V-ets erythroblastosis virus E26 oncogene homolog 2 knockdown effect on lung cancer cells
description: Analysis of H441 lung cancer cells transfected with siRNA targeting V-ets erythroblastosis virus E26 oncogene homolog 2 (ETS2). ETS2 transcription factor is an evolutionarily conserved gene that is deregulated in cancer. Results provide insight into the role of ETS2 in lung cancer.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Transciption factor Meis1 deficiency effect on lineage-negative bone marrow cells
description: Analysis of lineage-negative bone marrow cells following in vitro deletion of the transcription factor Meis1. Meis1 is a member of the 3-amino acid loop extension family of homeodomain proteins. Results provide insight into the role of Meis1 in hematopoiesis.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: U2OS osteosarcoma cell line response to strigolactone analogs ST362 and MEB55: 6 hours
description: Analysis of U2OS cells treated with strigolactone (SL) analog ST362 or MEB55 for 6hr. SL is a plant hormone. SL analogs potently inhibit growth of breast cancer cells. Results provide insight into molecular mechanisms underlying the anti-tumorigenic effects of SL analogs towards cancer cells.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: U2OS osteosarcoma cell line response to strigolactone analogs ST362 and MEB55: 24 hours
description: Analysis of U2OS cells treated with strigolactone (SL) analog ST362 or MEB55 for 24hr. SL is a plant hormone. SL analogs potently inhibit growth of breast cancer cells. Results provide insight into molecular mechanisms underlying the anti-tumorigenic effects of SL analogs towards cancer cells.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Lamin A exon 9 deletion effect on fibroblasts
description: Analysis of fibroblasts from mutants deleted for exon 9 of Lamin A (LMNA). Mutant deleted for exon 9 of LMNA is a model for the segmental premature aging disease Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria (HGPS). Results provide insight into the molecular etiology and pathology of HGPS.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: KSR2 deficiency effect on white adipose tissue
description: Analysis of white adipose tissues of mutants lacking the kinase suppressor of Ras 2 (KSR2). KSR2 functions as a molecular scaffold to regulate the MAP kinases ERK1/2. Result provide insight into the role of KSR2 in white adipose tissues.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Androgen deprivation effect on CD4 T-cells
description: Analysis of CD4 T cells from castrated animals. Testosterone levels had been observed to be inversely correlated to the strength of the immune response. Results provide insight into the molecular basis of this observation.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2-positive breast cancer brain metastases
description: Analysis of HER2+ breast cancer brain metastasis specimens and HER2+ nonmetastatic primary breast tumors. Samples were matched for patient age upon primary tumor detection and ER status of primary tumor. Results provide insight into the molecular basis of HER2+ breast cancer outgrowth in the brain.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Multiple myeloma and bone lesions
description: Comparison of gene expression in bone marrow plasma cells of multiple myeloma patients with and without bone lesions. Osteolytic lesions increase in multiple myeloma patients.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Hutchinson Gilford Progeria Syndrome cell line response to oncogenic challenge
description: Analysis of skin fibroblasts from Hutchinson Gilford Progeria Syndrome (HGPS) patients challenged by retroviral introduction of telomerase reverse transcriptase (TERT), V12-HRAS and SV40 large and small T antigens. Results provide insight into molecular basis of transformation resistance in HGPS.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Chronic high-calorie diet effect on Kras-driven lung tumors
description: Analysis of lung tumors isolated from mice that develop KRAS-driven lung tumors. The KrasG12D mice were fed a high-calorie diet (HCD) starting 12 wk before tumor induction; tumors were collected 11 wk after tumor induction. Results provide insight into HCD effects on KRAS-driven lung tumorigenesis.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Mutant isocitrate dehydrogenase 1 and 2 effect on hepatoblasts grown on collagen-coated plates
description: Analysis of hepatoblasts expressing mutant IDH1 (R132C) and mutant IDH2 (R172K) grown on collagen-coated plates. IDH genes are frequently mutated in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (IHCC). Results provide insight into molecular pathways by which IDH mutations lead to tumor formation.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Mutant isocitrate dehydrogenase 1 effect on hepatoblasts grown on uncoated plates
description: Analysis of mutant IDH1 (R132C)-expressing hepatoblasts that were grown on uncoated plates to induce hepatocyte differentiation. IDH genes are frequently mutated in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (IHCC). Results provide insight into the role of IDH1 in hepatocyte differentiation.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Erythroid differentiation: G1E model
description: Analysis of erythroid differentiation using G1E ER4 clone cells. Estradiol addition induces Gata-1 triggering synchronous differentiation. 30 hour time course corresponds to late burst-forming unit-erythroid stage through orthochromatic erythroblast stage.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: αSMA+ myofibroblast early depletion effect on pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma model
description: Analysis of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) tumors from PKT; aSMA-tk+ transgenics injected daily with ganciclovir at 4 to 4.5 weeks of age for 14 days or less to selectively deplete aSMA+ myofibroblasts. Results provide insight into the role of aSMA+ myofibroblasts in early-stage PDAC.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: αSMA+ myofibroblast late depletion effect on pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma model
description: Analysis of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) tumors from PKT; aSMA-tk+ transgenics injected daily with ganciclovir at 6 weeks of age for 10 days or less to selectively deplete aSMA+ myofibroblasts. Results provide insight into the role of aSMA+ myofibroblasts in late-stage PDAC.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: Anti-CTLA-4 immunotherapy effect on αSMA+ myofibroblast late-depleted pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma model
description: Analysis of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) tumors from PKT; aSMA-tk+ transgenics injected daily with ganciclovir at 6 weeks of age for 10 days or less to deplete aSMA+ myofibroblasts and treated with anti-CTLA4. Results provide insight into molecular basis of anti-CTLA4 therapy in PDAC.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: GATA3 ectopic expression in 293T cells
description: Examination of 293T epithelial kidney cells stably transfected with either wild type GATA3 or R367L mutant GATA3. GATA3 can be highly expressed in breast tumors. GATA3 variants may contribute to tumorigenesis.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array

dataset_title: GATA3 ectopic expression in 293T cells (dye-swap)
description: Examination of 293T epithelial kidney cells stably transfected with either wild type GATA3 or R367L mutant GATA3. GATA3 can be highly expressed in breast tumors. GATA3 variants may contribute to tumorigenesis.
assay_method: Expression profiling by array
